data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at the start of the year was GBP 1.882m. There was a small adverse prior-year development on reserves of GBP 0.1m (a strengthening) driven principally by uncertainty and adverse development related to prior natural catastrophe events (notably the elevated 2017 US hurricane and wildfire activity) and IBNR recalibration. The movement is small relative to opening reserves but reflects the residual uncertainty in the syndicate's catastrophe-exposed US property portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 0.1m (2017: release of GBP 0.2m).

In 2018, there has been an overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 0.1m (2017: surplus of GBP 0.2m) due primarily to an increase in claims estimates from uncertainty around 2017 catastrophe exposure unwinds.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development is reported in the notes as a GBP 0.1m deterioration in the net provisions for prior years. The syndicate has no reinsurers' share for technical provisions (reinsurers' share = GBP 0), so net = gross; therefore the net prior-year figure is treated as gross. The regulatory segmental analysis includes only a statement that all business is 'reinsurance accepted' rather than a multi-class breakdown.
